validation_policy: Strict absolute URL parsing and scheme validation.
whitespace_policy: Harmless surrounding whitespace is trimmed; original string not mutated for display.
control_character_policy: Payloads containing ASCII control characters [\x00-\x1F\x7F] are rejected.
malformed_url_behavior: Caught by native URL() parser and rejected as INVALID_URL.
localhost_private_ip_policy: Classified as SECURITY_WARNING. Not rejected outright, but explicitly flagged as untrusted/local.
userinfo_policy: Allowed and preserved. No stripping or rejection.
xss_test_results: Displayed purely as text via React JSX to prevent execution.
long_url_test_results: Payloads exceeding 2048 characters are rejected as TOO_LONG.
